1. The table below shows the probability distribution of a discrete random variable X, where k is a constant and n is an integer.
x: -1, n, 3, 6
P(X=x): 0.1, 0.3, k, 0.2
(a) Find k. Hence express Var(X) in terms of n.
(b) It is given that Var(X)=3.69. Find Var(10X^2-9).
(6 marks)
